description:
Episode 27 of a daily journey through the universe. 🔵
We visit HD 189733b: a deep blue world colored by glass clouds, 8,700 km/h winds that blow glass rain sideways, and a smell of rotten eggs found by Webb in 2024.

➡️ Tomorrow, Episode 28: Next stop, rogue planets. Worlds with no sun at all.

Follow so you don't miss a stop. A new episode every day.

segments.text: Episode twenty-seven. Next stop... a planet where it rains glass.
From far away, HD one eight nine seven three three b looks like a calm, deep blue world, a bit like Earth.
segments.headline: A deep blue world

segments.text: But its blue color comes from clouds full of tiny glass particles.
segments.headline: Blue from glass

segments.text: Its winds blow at about eight thousand seven hundred kilometers per hour.
So the glass rain doesn't fall down. It flies sideways.
segments.headline: Glass rain, sideways

segments.text: And in twenty twenty-four, Webb found its air contains hydrogen sulfide. It would smell like rotten eggs.
Tomorrow, a planet with no sun at all. Next stop: rogue planets, drifting alone through the dark. Follow, so you don't miss episode twenty-eight.
